manualDivergences.reason: luaL_dofile is luaL_loadfile followed by lua_pcall: the load can raise only a memory error and the call is protected, so the SDK remark is narrower than the manual.
Lua 5.3.6 runs luaL_getmetatable (lua_getfield on the registry with a string key, which may create that string) before lua_setmetatable; the SDK remark keeps the allocation the manual omits.

productionExceptions.justification: PushUncheckedFunction pushes a light C function (zero upvalues) in the statement right after lua_checkstack(Pointer, 1) succeeded; LuaDirectApiBoundaryGuardTests pins that exact shape.
FromStack reads the error value with lua_tolstring only in its LuaType.String case, so a string is returned as is and nothing is allocated.
TryReadUtf8 returns false unless lua_type is LUA_TSTRING, so a string is returned as is, nothing is allocated and the stack slot is never rewritten.

rows.condition: Zero upvalues, immediately after lua_checkstack(L, 1) succeeded on the same path: Lua 5.3.6 then pushes a light C function without allocating.
The value is already a string: lua_type returned LUA_TSTRING on the same path, so nothing is converted, allocated or rewritten.
